# plot_windows { #mofography.visualize.plot_windows }

`visualize.plot_windows(connections, **kwargs)`

It takes a list of connections and returns a plotly scatter trace of the windows.

## Parameters

| Name          | Type   | Description                                                        | Default    |
|---------------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| `connections` |        | a list of lists, output from the connections from regions function | _required_ |

## Returns

| Type   | Description                              |
|--------|------------------------------------------|
|        | A plotly scatter 3D trace of the windows |
